b471-forced-adulthood: The problem is, that some people do not have access to their adult functions at will. Instead, they may go blank, access an inherited inner critic, or feel like a child part who may be playing at being an adult (what I call forced adulthood). Telling them to just access their adult is like telling them to just be able to fly.
b471-three-roles:
Gently change some aspect of their pattern (location, volume, space, posture, speed, etc.).

Put 3 good adults in with the person (Nurturer, Protector, and Guide). In real life they’re all part of the one inner adult, so we can imagine them splitting apart if need be and coming together as well.
